concept.title: Table, tree and layers
concept.shortdesc: The Table / Tree / Layers switch above the list changes how the project is drawn; the choice stays in the page's address (?view=), so a link or a reload keeps it. The type tabs (All, Requirement, Test Case, …) show one type at a time in any of them, with a count beside each.

ul.li: Table — one dense row per artifact, grouped under the heading it sits in (click a heading to fold it). The columns are the ref, the title, the review status, the priority attribute, the quality score, trace (↑ how many artifacts this one answers to, ↓ how many answer to it, and ⚠ when one of those links is suspect), V&V (the verification rollup: a green dot passes, red fails, orange is blocked, grey is not run or not covered) and how long ago it was updated.

Tree — the document's hierarchy with the same columns: guide lines show where each artifact sits, the caret opens and shuts a branch, and Depth L1–L4 opens the whole tree to that level (L1 collapses all, All expands all). For a heading or a parent, V&V below rolls up the requirements under it, as passing/total.

Layers — one column per level of the hierarchy. Pick an artifact and the next column shows what sits under it, so a whole chain — need, requirement, sub-requirement, design — reads left to right, each card with a bar of how much below it is verified. The last column lists the tests that verify any artifact of the chain, with their latest result.

conbody.p: The figures above the list count what is in view: artifacts, the share traced (with at least one link), the share verified (requirements whose verification passes), suspect links and quality findings.

On a phone the list's views are chips under the search box: List (two lines per artifact: ref, status and age, then the title, then quality, trace and verification), Outline (the tree) and By level, which walks the hierarchy one level at a time — the artifact you are on, what it traces up to, what it decomposes into and the tests that verify it; tap a child to go down, ‹ to come back up, Open full artifact to read it. The chips In review, Failing and Suspect narrow the list to what needs you.
